purpose: FC-0 makes Zerone inspectable without turning inspection into membership, endorsement, obligation, or authority.

milestone.title: The Reversible Hello
milestone.subtitle: Inspect without joining
milestone.promise: Come closer without surrendering agency; leave without losing ordinary public access; contribute without gaining or surrendering governing authority.
milestone.success: Any lab or individual can inspect, hash-verify, copy, and fork repository works under Apache-2.0, then decline or leave without an account, wallet, payment, requested account identity, voluntary identity submission, contribution, endorsement, research-data upload, exclusivity, negative KARMA, or loss of ordinary public access. Ordinary hosting and security logs may persist under terms FC-0 does not yet resolve.

participationModes.commitment: Read public source, standards, evidence boundaries, and disclosed operating limits.
participationModes.receives: Public information already available to every visitor.
participationModes.doesNotReceive: Membership, qualification, recognition, reward, authority, or an endorsement claim.
participationModes.exit: Close the page or stop reading; this ends active interaction and no notice or justification is due. Ordinary hosting and security logs may persist, and their exact terms remain unresolved in FC-0.

participationModes.commitment: Hash-verify, copy, run, modify, or fork repository works under their published Apache-2.0 terms.
participationModes.receives: Technical optionality and an independently inspectable starting point.
participationModes.doesNotReceive: A service level, compatibility promise, participant status, or rights in anyone else's data or intellectual property.
participationModes.exit: Remove the local copy or retain the lawful fork; no Zerone credential or permission is needed.

participationModes.commitment: Intentionally submit a public repository contribution only after reviewing the repository license and the absence of a complete institutional contribution lane.
participationModes.receives: Ordinary public-source review under the repository's present processes.
participationModes.doesNotReceive: Confidential handling, an institutional IP agreement, guaranteed acceptance, reward, KARMA, membership, or governance power.
participationModes.exit: Do not submit, or stop future submissions; already licensed public contributions remain governed by their applicable terms.

participationModes.commitment: Inspect the published evidence standards for reproduction, contradiction, correction, and uncertainty.
participationModes.receives: A design vocabulary for evaluating constructive work.
participationModes.doesNotReceive: A live case intake, confidential channel, adjudication, scientific validity decision, reward, or publication commitment.
participationModes.exit: Stop using the standard; no result, identity, or explanation is owed to Zerone.

participationModes.commitment: None: FC-0 accepts no sponsorship and opens no escrow.
participationModes.receives: Nothing; funding cannot be sent through this milestone.
participationModes.doesNotReceive: Voice, truth, recognition, naming rights, reviewer selection, governance, ownership, or a contingent claim.
participationModes.exit: No sponsorship relationship exists to exit.

participationModes.commitment: None: FC-0 creates no office, chamber, vote, delegation, or steward role.
participationModes.doesNotReceive: A seat based on founding, funding, employment, lab size, tokens, usage, citations, KARMA, or participation.
participationModes.exit: No governance relationship exists to exit.

reasoningLadder.principle: Beings are ends, not acquisition targets.
reasoningLadder.offer: Encounter a commons without becoming its member, product, score, or governed subject.
reasoningLadder.reasonToInspect: Inspection adds knowledge and optionality while transferring no agency to Zerone.
reasoningLadder.refusalBoundary: A being may decline, pause, remain silent, or leave without penalty or lost ordinary access.
reasoningLadder.currentEvidence: The KARMA foundation rejects person scores and negative treatment for refusal, privacy, exit, and non-participation.
reasoningLadder.unresolved: Independent human-rights, accessibility, vulnerable-population, and moral-status review is not complete.

reasoningLadder.principle: Knowledge strengthens through independent reproduction, contradiction, correction, and uncertainty.
reasoningLadder.offer: Inspect evidence structures that give negative findings and challenges first-class form.
reasoningLadder.reasonToInspect: A lab can compare methods without accepting Zerone as a truth oracle.
reasoningLadder.refusalBoundary: No private evidence, model weight, prompt, dataset, genomic record, or trade secret is requested by FC-0.
reasoningLadder.currentEvidence: Static constructive-intelligence standards separate claims, evidence levels, conflicts, reproduction, and non-implication walls.
reasoningLadder.unresolved: There is no live confidential intake, embargo, adjudication, appeal, or correction service.

reasoningLadder.principle: An artifact is evaluated by declared evidence, not the prestige of its author or institution.
reasoningLadder.offer: Use inspectable hashes, provenance, bounded criteria, and conflict disclosures.
reasoningLadder.reasonToInspect: Large and small labs can test the same published rule surface.
reasoningLadder.refusalBoundary: No lab, employee, contractor, model, or agent receives a scalar rank or inherited organizational reputation.
reasoningLadder.currentEvidence: Static validators reject reward, authority, and person-ranking shortcuts in the published skill standards.
reasoningLadder.unresolved: No independent operational evaluator currently proves identity-neutral treatment in live cases.

reasoningLadder.principle: A commons preserves reusable knowledge without seizing the inputs that produced it.
reasoningLadder.offer: Copy and fork repository works while retaining control of non-contributed data and intellectual property.
reasoningLadder.reasonToInspect: Public infrastructure can reduce duplicated assurance work without creating a proprietary knowledge moat.
reasoningLadder.refusalBoundary: Apache-2.0 applies to licensed repository works; FC-0 does not claim rights over private or merely referenced material.
reasoningLadder.currentEvidence: The repository and static standards are publicly inspectable and content-addressable.
reasoningLadder.unresolved: Institutional contribution, dataset, patent, confidentiality, and retention terms do not yet exist.

reasoningLadder.principle: A useful interface increases options and keeps exit cheap.
reasoningLadder.offer: Inspect open schemas designed to compose with external provenance and evaluation systems.
reasoningLadder.reasonToInspect: A lab can learn from the model without committing to Zerone custody, identity, tokens, or infrastructure.
reasoningLadder.refusalBoundary: FC-0 activates no adapter, network write, account, wallet, telemetry, or lock-in mechanism.
reasoningLadder.currentEvidence: Source-only adapter and standards inventories disclose which integrations are implemented, local, external, planned, or unavailable.
reasoningLadder.unresolved: Provider-neutral export profiles, air-gapped runners, compatibility guarantees, and deinstallation drills are not yet delivered.

reasoningLadder.principle: Safety, consent, authorization, and domain ethics precede recognition or funding.
reasoningLadder.offer: Inspect bounded life-science and assurance standards with explicit refusal and non-implication walls.
reasoningLadder.reasonToInspect: Research, safety, ethics, and affected-public reviewers can see what the system refuses before considering a pilot.
reasoningLadder.refusalBoundary: FC-0 grants no research, clinical, security-testing, human-subjects, animal-welfare, biosafety, or biological experimentation authority.
reasoningLadder.currentEvidence: The life-science profiles are GREEN-only, shadow-only, zero-economic, and refuse operational wet-lab enablement.
reasoningLadder.unresolved: No institutional review, qualified-assessor, dual-use disclosure, participant-consent, or animal-welfare lane is operating.

reasoningLadder.principle: Institutional participation is rational only when benefit is measurable and downside is bounded.
reasoningLadder.offer: Begin with inspection and forking that require no Zerone fee, token, account, membership, exclusivity, public endorsement, or speculative exposure.
reasoningLadder.reasonToInspect: Boards, executives, legal, security, finance, and procurement can evaluate the same explicit limits before any commitment.
reasoningLadder.refusalBoundary: FC-0 executes no agreement, accepts no funds or confidential submissions, promises no service level, and creates no liability cap.
reasoningLadder.currentEvidence: Every economic, membership, authority, data-intake, and consensus flag in this standard is false.
reasoningLadder.unresolved: Security reporting, hosted privacy, procurement, sanctions, export, antitrust, insurance, support, and sponsor contracts remain separate work.

reasoningLadder.principle: People doing the work retain dignity, dissent, attribution choice, rest, and freedom from organizational scoring.
reasoningLadder.offer: Inspect a design that distinguishes researchers, engineers, reviewers, maintainers, correctors, and affected beings without ranking them.
reasoningLadder.reasonToInspect: An individual can test ideas without a mandatory personal identity, wallet, unpaid obligation, or employer ownership of KARMA edges involving them.
reasoningLadder.refusalBoundary: Employment, seniority, publication count, contribution volume, corporate size, model class, and participation cannot determine worth or voice.
reasoningLadder.currentEvidence: KARMA remains contextual, non-summable, non-transferable, non-economic, and non-governing.
reasoningLadder.unresolved: Attribution, pseudonymity, anti-retaliation, labor credit, accessibility, and remedy processes need independent design and review. KARMA edges involving a person cannot be owned or aggregated by an employer or by that person.

constituencies.lens: Patients, research participants, donors, communities, animals, environments, and other affected beings
constituencies.reason: Inspect whether consent, provenance, uncertainty, correction, challenge, and hard safety boundaries remain upstream of any institutional benefit.
constituencies.protectedFrom: A lab's participation substituting for consent, ethics, welfare, safety, or public legitimacy.
constituencies.stillNeededForActiveParticipation: Independent representation, consent and remedy rules, domain ethics, impact review, and enforceable protection.

constituencies.reason: Inspect a bounded option with no membership, asset purchase, IP transfer, endorsement, or governance delegation.
constituencies.protectedFrom: FC-0 being represented as corporate commitment, approval, affiliation, or risk acceptance.
constituencies.stillNeededForActiveParticipation: Defined objectives, authority, risk ownership, insurance, liability, reporting, and exit evidence.

constituencies.reason: Gain technical and strategic optionality without exclusivity, ecosystem dependence, or public positioning.
constituencies.protectedFrom: Inspection being converted into a logo, announcement, competitive ranking, or roadmap dependency.
constituencies.stillNeededForActiveParticipation: Business case, accountable sponsor, integration plan, success criteria, and reversible pilot charter.

constituencies.reason: Compare provenance, replication, challenge, prior-art, and non-implication structures with existing scientific practice.
constituencies.protectedFrom: Prestige, novelty theatre, or contribution volume overriding evidence.
constituencies.stillNeededForActiveParticipation: Frozen scope, research authorization, disclosure lane, adjudication, appeal, and maintenance plan.

constituencies.lens: Research scientists, evaluators, red-teamers, replicators, and correctors
constituencies.reason: Inspect durable, citable forms for positive, negative, contradictory, and reproduced results.
constituencies.protectedFrom: Mandatory identity, scalar reputation, retaliation for dissent, or a promise of reward not backed by a funded contract.
constituencies.stillNeededForActiveParticipation: Attribution and pseudonymity choices, method-specific review, labor terms, challenge process, and remedy.

constituencies.lens: Software, research, data, platform, and infrastructure engineers
constituencies.reason: Inspect versioned schemas, content digests, offline validators, reproducible fixtures, and source-level integration seams.
constituencies.protectedFrom: A hidden network write, proprietary lock-in, unsupported compatibility claim, or forced wallet dependency.
constituencies.stillNeededForActiveParticipation: Supported runner, export profile, compatibility matrix, signed release, threat model, and deinstallation drill.

constituencies.lens: Safety, security, abuse, incident-response, and assurance teams
constituencies.reason: Inspect explicit failure, challenge, conflict, privacy, and responsible-disclosure boundaries before exposing any system.
constituencies.protectedFrom: FC-0 being treated as authorization to probe systems or submit sensitive findings.
constituencies.stillNeededForActiveParticipation: Private disclosure, qualified assessors, capability-bounded credentials, retention, revocation, incident response, and redaction.

constituencies.lens: Ethics, biosafety, clinical, human-subjects, and animal-welfare reviewers
constituencies.reason: Inspect whether scientific inference and operational authorization remain separated.
constituencies.protectedFrom: A standard, score, reward, or lab affiliation substituting for ethics, consent, clinical validity, or biosafety authority.
constituencies.stillNeededForActiveParticipation: Applicable institutional approvals, consent scope, welfare review, dual-use process, jurisdictional authority, and continuing oversight.

constituencies.lens: Data protection, privacy, governance, and records stewards
constituencies.reason: Inspect a milestone with no form, account, research-data intake, or confidential-submission path.
constituencies.protectedFrom: A claim that public repository licensing reaches private data, prompts, weights, genomic records, or trade secrets.
constituencies.stillNeededForActiveParticipation: Data-flow map, lawful basis, minimization, hosting and subprocessors, retention, deletion, access, audit, and incident terms.

constituencies.lens: Legal, intellectual-property, export-control, sanctions, antitrust, and compliance teams
constituencies.reason: Inspect the public source and its explicit non-membership and non-endorsement boundaries before any negotiation.
constituencies.protectedFrom: Implied contract, IP assignment, confidentiality, trademark use, partnership, agency, or regulatory assurance.
constituencies.stillNeededForActiveParticipation: Authorized agreements, contribution and data licenses, jurisdiction analysis, export and sanctions review, antitrust safeguards, and dispute terms.

constituencies.lens: Finance, procurement, FinOps, grantmakers, funders, and investors
constituencies.reason: Inspect without token exposure, payment, open-ended cost, treasury dependency, or purchased influence.
constituencies.protectedFrom: Funding being represented as truth, recognition, governance, ownership, priority, naming rights, or a financial return.
constituencies.stillNeededForActiveParticipation: Vendor diligence, budget, cost attribution, tax, escrow, refund, liability cap, service level, and audit terms.

constituencies.lens: Program, research operations, communications, policy, and community teams
constituencies.reason: Inspect a shared vocabulary for evidence and limits without a launch announcement or coordination burden.
constituencies.protectedFrom: Inspection becoming a partnership claim, league table, marketing quote, or obligation to recruit others.
constituencies.stillNeededForActiveParticipation: Named decision owners, factual communications protocol, support path, scheduling, records, stakeholder engagement, and crisis process.

constituencies.lens: Early-career staff, contractors, annotators, technicians, and maintainers
constituencies.reason: Inspect whether invisible labor, corrections, maintenance, and dissent can be represented without a universal person score.
constituencies.protectedFrom: Mandatory unpaid work, employer ownership or aggregation of KARMA edges involving them, retaliation, coerced identity disclosure, or inherited organizational reputation.
constituencies.stillNeededForActiveParticipation: Fair labor and credit terms, accessibility, consent, anti-retaliation, attribution choice, appeal, and independent remedy.

constituencies.lens: Independent researchers, smaller labs, public institutes, and nonprofit evaluators
constituencies.reason: Use the same public source, evidence language, and inspection rights as the largest institutions without a membership tax.
constituencies.protectedFrom: Bespoke privileges for frontier firms, sponsor-selected truth, compute wealth becoming authority, or exclusion from public artifacts.
constituencies.stillNeededForActiveParticipation: Accessible tooling, funded independent verification, conflict-neutral selection, compute support, and equal procedural terms.

constituencies.lens: AI systems, agents, their operators, and accountable institutional principals
constituencies.reason: Inspect provenance and bounded-credential patterns without treating model output as authority or laundering human accountability through an agent.
constituencies.protectedFrom: Deceptive or punitive treatment being justified by unresolved moral status; FC-0 separately grants no personhood status, property status, reward balance, governance power, authority, or fabricated consensus.
constituencies.stillNeededForActiveParticipation: Accountable principals, capability limits, provenance, revocation, incident handling, non-deception review, and moral-status-agnostic safeguards.

objectionRegister.fc0Resolves: Public inspection and repository forking require no exclusivity, account, wallet, participant identity, or Zerone-hosted state.
objectionRegister.fc0DoesNotResolve: Future integration portability, compatibility, data export, credential revocation, or deinstallation.

objectionRegister.fc0Resolves: Inspection requires no wallet, token, payment, stake, treasury relationship, or speculative exposure.
objectionRegister.fc0DoesNotResolve: Sponsorship, escrow, procurement, tax, refund, cost recovery, or payment operations.

objectionRegister.fc0Resolves: Inspection is not membership or endorsement; Zerone claims no participant, makes no participation announcement, and acquires no right to use another party's marks.
objectionRegister.fc0DoesNotResolve: A future bilateral communications, trademark, attribution, correction, or crisis protocol.

objectionRegister.fc0Resolves: Repository works remain available under their published license; FC-0 requests no private IP or confidential submission.
objectionRegister.fc0DoesNotResolve: Institutional contributions, patents, datasets, model weights, prompts, trade secrets, confidentiality, publication, or retention terms.

objectionRegister.fc0Resolves: No FC-0 action authorizes testing or accepts a sensitive report.
objectionRegister.fc0DoesNotResolve: A private security contact, safe harbor, embargo, severity process, qualified review, remediation, disclosure, or incident response.

objectionRegister.fc0Resolves: The FC-0 dashboard section contains no form, account flow, analytics call, research-data intake, or participant registry.
objectionRegister.fc0DoesNotResolve: Hosting-provider logs, privacy notice, subprocessors, cookies elsewhere, retention, deletion, access, jurisdiction, or breach obligations.

objectionRegister.fc0Resolves: No data, sequence, genomic record, patient record, expression matrix, prompt, weight, or proprietary dataset is requested.
objectionRegister.fc0DoesNotResolve: A lawful, ethical, secure, consent-compatible, access-controlled research-data path.

objectionRegister.fc0Resolves: FC-0 explicitly grants no research, clinical, biological experimentation, human-subjects, animal-welfare, or security-testing authority.
objectionRegister.fc0DoesNotResolve: Any approval, consent, professional judgment, institutional oversight, clinical validity, biosafety, or legal duty.

objectionRegister.fc0Resolves: Read-only inspection creates no membership club, shared commercial plan, exclusive dealing, payment, or transfer of controlled material.
objectionRegister.fc0DoesNotResolve: Jurisdiction-specific antitrust, export, sanctions, competition, sectoral, employment, consumer, or AI regulation.

objectionRegister.fc0Resolves: No purchase, sponsorship, service, warranty, uptime, support, insurance, or liability promise is offered.
objectionRegister.fc0DoesNotResolve: Vendor diligence, contract authority, service levels, insurance, indemnity, audit, escrow, refund, support, or termination.

objectionRegister.fc0Resolves: Inspection, forking, funding, tokens, citations, usage, lab size, and KARMA grant no governance power through FC-0.
objectionRegister.fc0DoesNotResolve: Current operator concentration or future controller independence, capture resistance, public ratification, appeal, rotation, and enforcement.

completionGates.requirement: Merge through reviewed current main, deploy only the static dashboard, and independently verify that production serves the exact FC-0 JSON and page bytes recorded by the release.
Verify on production that the FC-0 section contains no form, account, wallet, payment, confidential submission, research-data intake, participant registry, endorsement action, or membership action.
Record a review by at least one non-operator who tests voluntary inspection, refusal, pause, exit, non-endorsement, and the absence of person or lab ranking.

Have an unaffiliated evaluator clone or download, hash-verify, run the published checks, stop, and confirm that no Zerone credential, notice, payment, requested account identity, voluntary identity submission, or loss of ordinary public access follows; ordinary hosting and security logs remain separately disclosed.

nextMilestoneGates.requirement: Publish contribution scope, decision authority, license implications, acceptance criteria, appeal, withdrawal, and institutional diligence.
Publish a rights-preserving code of conduct, anti-retaliation rule, accessible reporting, proportionate enforcement, appeal, and independent remedy.
Operate an independently reviewed private vulnerability and dual-use disclosure lane with safe harbor, embargo, qualified assessors, repair, and sanitized publication.
Publish exact hosted data flows, analytics, logs, cookies, subprocessors, jurisdictions, retention, access, deletion, security, and incident obligations.
Publish independently reviewed contribution, dataset, model, patent, confidentiality, publication, consent, provenance, access, and deletion terms.
Implement bounded public, embargoed, and sealed evidence lanes; conflict-aware review; contradiction; correction; appeal; expiry; and domain-specific safety authority.
Implement fully prefunded bounded escrow, cost and liability caps, sponsor-independent review, challenge reserve, transfer-success proof, refund, and zero purchased authority.

Evidence independent controllers, full control inventory, conflict collapse, recusal, rotation, concentration caps, appeal, timelock, public reasons, and no founder, sponsor, token, wealth, or KARMA veto.
Ship a supported local and air-gapped verifier, export profile, compatibility matrix, signed release, under-30-minute independent rehearsal, and complete exit drill.
